Name: Master Pause Button
Author: adverserath
Description:
A small Stardew Valley mod that lets you assign a single key or controller button to toggle the host pause state.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Press a configured button to pause or resume the game[/*]
[*]Only works while you are the host/master player[/*]
[*]Shows a HUD message when the world is paused or resumed[/*]
[*]Default key is
[code]Pause[/code][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Master Pause Button
Manifest.Description: Assigns a button to toggle the host pause state in Stardew Valley.
